svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: ihopemoon
g.desc: Trap, you absolutely mysterious and pretty much famous but unknown for someone like me who barely knows you. Happy Birthday, hope your day traps you to be all happy 💞

g.title: bbea
g.desc: Happy birthday, gorgeous! You deserve all the happiness in the world today and always. You make the world a better place just by being in it. Happy birthday to the prettiest soul with the kindest heart.

g.title: silveraine
g.desc: Happiest birthday trap! I hope this day treats you well and you always keep smiling and shine brightly!

g.title: Iisichka
g.desc: Heyy, I don't think we've interacted before, but couldn't let your birthday pass without wishing you! Happy Birthdayyy!! 🎀 Hope you have a beautiful day and an amazing year ahead. Lots of happiness your way! 💗

g.title: xyz_sha
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap...May all your wishes come true this year.. be given happiness, health and all good things come to you..🥳🎂
